segments.note: The claimed destinations collectively retain capability expression/exercise without an authority commit, durable acceptance-state governance, orthogonal axes and the source issue reference.

activation.note: Activation covers classification, terminal-contract and ID changes, missing family assertions, and review/validation of unchanged definitions. Variant-only and unrelated wagon edits do not trigger a family decision. Task/file/operation labels are directly observable; diff and validator-finding detection explicitly require new observers. The declared activation elaborations do not change the source's classification scope.

audit.summary: All 17 segments survive at their claimed destinations, with source metadata separated from coder-facing decisions. The rewrite preserves the conjunctive delivery test, mandatory family assertion, orthogonal variant axis and prohibition on encoding family in IDs; there are no waivers, shared-node moves or undeclared additions.

segmentChecks.note: The then field supplies both allowed family values, and avoid[2] plus verifier_detail[3] preserve orthogonality from variant categories 0-3.
prefer[0] identifies the terminal contract as source of truth and family as its validator-checked assertion; avoid[0], avoid[1], and evidence[2] preserve the mandatory assertion and ID prohibition.
The rationale is distributed without material loss: behavior and delivery semantics remain in why and prefer, axis orthogonality remains in avoid[2], and audit retains #1083.
verifier_detail[1] retains the train -> {family, definition} shape, while verifier_detail[3] and avoid[2] retain the named variant rule, values 0-3, and independence of the axes.
prefer[1] preserves every listed behavior activity, the system-under-examination context, and the absence of an authority commit.
prefer[2] retains governance of accepted-system state through a durable Acceptance Authority commit, and then retains the exact commit-receipt terminal contract.
then and verifier_detail[0] preserve the conjunctive delivery test and the otherwise-behavior branch without weakening either condition.
The mandatory field, named validator, non-source-of-truth status, and prohibition on an ID digit are all explicit across avoid, evidence, and verifier_detail.

risks: No concrete train-definition example shows where to inspect the declared terminal contract, so an agent unfamiliar with the schema must locate that syntax; the decision procedure itself is nevertheless explicit and complete.

unobservable: change: diff-level addition, change, or removal of family, terminal contract, or train ID requires the declared new observer
finding: planner.train.family-matches-terminal-contract requires the declared validator-finding observer

review.summary: I agree with the auditor's PASS: all knowledge-rich segments checked are preserved, including the exact conjunctive delivery test, mandatory family assertion, orthogonal variant axis, and ID prohibition. A weak planner receives a clear decision procedure, although diff-level changes and validator findings are not currently observable without the two explicitly declared observers.
